The solution of the differential equation [latex]\frac{dy}{dx}+\frac{y}{x}=x[/latex], with the condition that y = 1 at x = 1, is
questions.explanation: [latex]  \frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}+\frac{y}{x}=x, \; y\left ( 1 \right )=1[/latex] This is a linear differential equation [latex]\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}+Py =Q [/latex] with [latex]P=\frac{1}{x}[/latex] and [latex]Q=x[/latex] IF = Integrating Factor [latex]    =e^{\int Pdx}=e^{\int \frac{1}{x}dx}=e^{\ln x}=x[/latex] Solution is, [latex] \begin{aligned}  y.IF&=\int Q\left ( IF \right )dx+C \\   y.x&=\int \left ( x.x \right )dx+C \\   yx&=\int x^{2}dx+C \\   yx&=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+C \\  y&=\frac{x^{2}}{3}+\frac{C}{x} \end{aligned}[/latex] Now, [latex]y(1)=1[/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \; \frac{1^{2}}{3}+\frac{C}{1} =1 \; \Rightarrow \; C=\frac{2}{3}[/latex] So the solution is [latex]y=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+\frac{2}{3x}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html:
[latex] \frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}+\frac{y}{x}=x, \; y\left ( 1 \right )=1[/latex]
This is a linear differential equation [latex]\frac{\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}+Py =Q [/latex] with [latex]P=\frac{1}{x}[/latex] and [latex]Q=x[/latex]
IF = Integrating Factor
[latex] =e^{\int Pdx}=e^{\int \frac{1}{x}dx}=e^{\ln x}=x[/latex]
Solution is,
[latex] \begin{aligned} y.IF&=\int Q\left ( IF \right )dx+C \\ y.x&=\int \left ( x.x \right )dx+C \\ yx&=\int x^{2}dx+C \\ yx&=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+C \\ y&=\frac{x^{2}}{3}+\frac{C}{x} \end{aligned}[/latex]
Now, [latex]y(1)=1[/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \; \frac{1^{2}}{3}+\frac{C}{1} =1 \; \Rightarrow \; C=\frac{2}{3}[/latex]
So the solution is [latex]y=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+\frac{2}{3x}[/latex]
